_about: SSO string Performance patches: slur range against note length (IOI). tools/soundlibraries/swell_vs_length.py (its header has the method and result). Measured 2026-10-13 on the Windows test VM: kthost (offline VST 3 host), Kontakt 8 + SSO, each patch from MuseScore's resaved setup (library defaults), 44.1 kHz, 3 passes. cells: section / CC1 / variant (B plain, F1 / F2 with one / two 136 ms notes at note 6 / 6-7) / IOI ms: slur ranges (dB, 3-pass median of the perceived level over 136.4 ms from note-on + legatoDelay; first and last notes left out), sigma (pass-to-pass SD), noise p50 / p90 (Monte Carlo slur of 4, median of 3), levels per pattern. Measurement only: the renderer does not read this file.
result: No IOI from 100 to 1000 ms measures flat: every section x CC1 x IOI cell has median slur range 1.4-8.2 dB against a noise floor p90 of 0.1-1.0 dB, and ranges grow from ~2-3 dB at 100-136 ms to ~4-6 dB at 500-1000 ms. No skip rule by length. A 136 ms note inside a slow slur changes itself and the next note (two fast notes: the next two) by ~1-2 dB; notes before it stay at noise.
